reasoning: Extending existing partial annotation implementation. Multiple files (6-10) but contained to single frontend service. No external integrations, no infrastructure changes. Uses existing tech stack (Three.js, Zustand, Dexie).

scope.notes: Will modify: annotationStore (add edit/freehand), AnnotationLayer (implement arrow heads, text, freehand), useAnnotationInteraction (drawing logic), AnnotationToolbar (new tools), playbookStore (persistence integration), possibly add new utility components for text rendering

integrations.notes: All required libraries already in use: Three.js for rendering, @react-three/drei for Text component, Zustand for state, Dexie for persistence. No new external dependencies needed.

infrastructure.notes: Uses existing IndexedDB schema. Playbook model already has annotations field as placeholder (annotations?: any[]). No infrastructure changes required.

knowledge.notes: Annotation store, layer, and persistence patterns already exist. Text rendering can use @react-three/drei Text component (already a dependency). Arrow rendering uses existing line geometry with cone for arrowhead.

concerns: Persistence integration could corrupt playbooks if annotations schema is wrong

Free-hand drawing performance with many points in Three.js

risk.notes: Medium risk due to data persistence concerns and multiple feature types. Careful testing needed for save/load operations.

validation_recommendations.reasoning: Multiple annotation types with persistence require unit tests for each annotation type and integration tests to verify playbook save/load correctly preserves annotations. Medium risk due to data persistence concerns.
